case_title: Mritunjoy Biswas v. Pranab @ Kuti Biswas and Another
aggravating_circumstances: Abscondence of accused, non-examination of treating doctor
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who was the husband of the deceased, was present in the house with his wife when a gunshot was fired through the eastern window, resulting in the wife's death. The husband and the nephew of the deceased arrived at the scene and took the victim to the hospital. The investigating officer registered a case under Section 302 IPC. The trial court convicted the accused of murder and sentenced him to life imprisonment. The High Court acquitted the accused, citing discrepancies in the evidence and the absence of the weapon. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's acquittal, finding the evidence credible and the non-recovery of the weapon did not affect the prosecution case.
